backend/main.mo: Motoko backend with access control, media upload validation, user profiles, live session types, and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collected short summaries of numerous frontend components and pages for reference.
frontend/.env.example: Environment variable template documenting II settings, canister IDs, network mode, and deployment guidance.
frontend/docs/ic-mainnet-deployment.md: Mainnet deployment guide explaining prerequisites, setup, build, and deploy steps for OmniStream.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React frontend and mounting the root element.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Custom-domain allowlist specifying ommistream.net domains for IC routing.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring hash-based routing, splash screen timing, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper with navigation, footer, floating action button, and backend availability banner logic.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Provides a sign-in/sign-out button using Internet Identity, handling login state and cache clearing on logout or errors.
frontend/src/components/BackendUnavailab: Displays an error banner when the backend is unreachable and gives guidance based on domain and reload options.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Shows a centered placeholder with an icon, title, and description for empty content views.
frontend/src/components/FloatingActionBu: Renders an authenticated-only floating action menu for uploading videos, shorts, or starting a live stream.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with branding, navigation links, community info, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx: Renders the top navigation bar with links, user profile info, and authentication controls.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting new users to enter and save a display name.
frontend/src/components/ShortCard.tsx: Card component showing a short video preview with title and formatted duration, linking to its watch page.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Full-screen splash screen displaying a branded image during initial load.
frontend/src/components/UploadForm.tsx: Form for uploading videos or shorts with duration checks, progress tracking, and mutation-based submission.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Displays a clickable video card with thumbnail, duration, date, and title using media metadata.
frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx: Implements a custom video player with play/pause, seek, volume, mute, and fullscreen controls.
frontend/src/components/ViewerTimer.tsx: Provides a timer UI that counts down between two times and triggers a callback when finished.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, providing identity state, login, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating media, user profiles, and uploading content.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the personalized feed with videos and shorts, showing a profile setup modal when needed and handling loading or empty states.
frontend/src/pages/LiveDetailsPage.tsx: Shows details of a specific live session, handles ending sessions for owners, and displays loading or not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/LivePage.tsx: Lists active live sessions and provides a form for authenticated users to start a new session, with profile setup checks.
frontend/src/pages/ShortsPage.tsx: Fetches and displays all shorts in a grid, with a loading indicator and an empty state fallback.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: Handles media uploads, requiring authentication and profile setup, and redirects to the watch page after a successful upload.
frontend/src/pages/WatchPage.tsx: Plays a selected video or short, showing metadata and handling backend errors or missing media.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters across navigation using sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining content paths, dark mode, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing OmniStream's goals, features, issues, and architectural notes for building and deploying the video-sharing site.
